verdict.rationale: Unity ships AI features (the AI Assistant, generators metered by Unity Credits, and an MCP server), so a training-data opt-out is a fair question to ask. The evidence pack documents no setting, policy or contractual control that stops user data or prompts from being used to train AI models. Community complaints about telemetry 'phoning home' concern a different subject, so they do not count here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
